story.title: A meal prepared a different way
story.body: We opened this restaurant in one of the oldest alleys in Mafra, right in front of the National Palace, and called it «Escondidinho» because it really is hidden — a name that goes back generations, to 1943. We wrap our guests in a comfortable, beautiful setting: the sounds and aromas drifting from the kitchen, the creative interior, the mouth-watering flavours. Inside, music and calm set the mood for a meal meant to be taken slowly. Two separate dining rooms seat 36 guests in total. To go with it all there is a good wine list — and, always served with a smile, we look forward to your visit.

dishes.burrata: Burrata with toasted bread and bacon, drizzled with truffle olive oil and balsamic vinegar.
dishes.risottoCamarao: A rich, comforting dish in which the creamy texture of the risotto meets succulent prawns in a Brazilian-style moqueca.
dishes.bacalhauNatas: A Portuguese classic: shredded salt cod sautéed and folded into potatoes, béchamel and cream. Creamy and full of flavour.
dishes.ovosRotos: A bed of fries topped with soft-yolked fried eggs, presunto ham, cooked ham and linguiça sausage — a true explosion of flavours.
dishes.tagyke: An inspired fusion of three culinary influences — taco, gyros and kebab — hence the name. Chef Hélder's signature dish: halal chicken breast sautéed with peppers and onion, served with golden fries, a fresh salad and a spiced sauce.
dishes.arrozDePato: A classic Portuguese delicacy, finished in the oven: the duck rice takes on a delicately golden crust, topped with slices of chouriço.
dishes.bifeCortador: Sirloin steak topped with a fried egg. Served with fries.
dishes.bife3Pimentas: Sirloin steak in a three-pepper sauce — green, pink and black peppercorns. Served with potatoes.
dishes.bifeReducaoVinho: Sirloin steak with a Madeira and Port wine reduction. Served with potatoes and pickled red cabbage.
dishes.francesinha: Layers of bread filled with rump steak, linguiça, ham, Tuscan sausage and Limiano cheese, topped with an egg and doused in a special spicy sauce.
dishes.alhoFrancesBras: Finely sliced leek sautéed with onion, garlic and straw potatoes, folded into beaten eggs with fresh parsley.
dishes.tagykeVegetariano: The vegetarian take on our signature dish: soy sautéed with peppers and onion, golden fries, a fresh salad and a spiced sauce.
dishes.risottoFunghi: Slowly cooked in stock until creamy, then combined with a selection of fresh mushrooms. Delicate, aromatic flavours.

team.title: The Team
team.intro: Welcome! It is with great joy that we receive you — smile, breathe and enjoy your experience here in our restaurant. We hope this house becomes your house of choice for many years!

memorial.label: In memoriam
memorial.body: They say that cooking is an art and a passion. And I couldn't agree more: whenever I prepare a dish, I do it with the same desire I had when I first started experimenting for myself and my friends. Cooking is like painting a picture or composing a song — colouring a plate with the colours nature gives us, and what an enormous palette I have at my disposal every day. The sound of meat on the grill, the onion and peppers jumping on the hot plate while the sliced meat of the tagyke turns golden, the cheese melting over the francesinhas as they leave the oven, the unmistakable smell of charcoal grilling or of the fresh herbs that lift a dish, like brush strokes of paint. There is so much you can do with this desire to create, recreate, innovate — to get your hands dirty without fear, to feel the ingredients, to knead the dough. Cooking is always a unique experience, and one I recommend to everyone.

sections.intro: This policy describes how Restaurante Escondidinho ({legalName}) handles personal data collected through this website.
sections.collect: We only collect the data you send us through the reservation form: name, email, phone number, requested date and time, party size, preferred area and any notes you choose to include.
sections.use: The data is used exclusively to answer your reservation request and contact you to confirm it. We do not use it for marketing, do not share it with third parties and do not build profiles.
sections.store: Your reservation request is delivered to us by email through the Resend sending service. This website keeps no customer database and uses no tracking cookies.
sections.rights: You may ask us at any time to access, correct or delete your data. Contact us by email at {privacyEmail} or by post at {address}.
sections.changes: We may update this policy when needed. Changes are published on this page.
